title: REQ · Worker holds an exclusive file lock so only one runs per World
summary: File lock Acquire fails with ErrLocked while another holder exists
description: Context: the worker must run one execution per World at a time. Desired behavior: lock.Acquire(path) creates the lock file exclusively and Release removes it. Expected result: a second Acquire returns ErrLocked. Why: prevents concurrent executions.
acceptance_criteria: Given no lock file, when Acquire runs, then it succeeds and the file contains the pid
Given a held lock, when Acquire runs again, then it returns an error satisfying errors.Is(err, ErrLocked)
Given Release was called, when Acquire runs again, then it succeeds
technical_constraints: os.OpenFile with O_CREATE|O_EXCL; no external dependencies
